newsitem.title: UK: Brixton Estates up after Capel comment.
newsitem.headline: Brixton Estates up after Capel comment.

text.p: Shares in Brixton Estates Plc rose in active trade on Monday as analysts at HSBC James Capel highlighted the stock in a review of the UK property sector, dealers said.
The stock was up 5p at 175-1/2 by 1345 GMT in volume of 3.7 million shares.

Sources said Capel analysts had highlighted Brixton on valuation grounds, pinpointing its above-average yield, and also because it was heavily exposed to the industrial property market tipped for strong growth in the Financial Times' influential Lex column.
Analysts at the brokerage declined comment.
Other leading property stocks were also higher, with British Land Plc up 4p at 559-1/2, Slough Estates Plc up 6p at 295 and Hammerson Plc up 4-1/2p at 436.
